findings.issue: The window and the full plan are read at two different moments from a live ledger and plan. In lw2/lw3, the full plan's evidence (_evidence_of(full_path), line 2792) is read only after the step has finished copying and reading the window (line 2779). Inside the step, full = evidence(src_plan) (831) is read before the plan/shards are re-read and before copytree (901). In this repo's own checkout, the drive appends rows to docs/audit/evidence/*.jsonl and rewrites the plan while other trees run. A row or pointer that lands between the two reads makes a subject read differently in the two readings, so lw2 or the step goes red with no defect behind it. CI's static checkout cannot show this.
findings.resolution: Read both sides over the same bytes. In the step, take the full reading after copying, from the copied plan and ledger, or snapshot plan+shards+ledger once and derive both readings from the snapshot. In lw2, take the full reading before running the step and re-read once on disagreement, so a moving ledger is told apart from a real disagreement.
